name: Enkou JK ~Donna Play mo Kane Shidai~
original_name: 援交JK～どんなプレイも金次第～
source:
The protagonist is a certain salaryman. He spends his life going between work and home.
But one day he meets a teenage girl, and his daily life changes completely.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE146777.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位工薪族。他一生都在工作和家庭之间度过。
但有一天，他遇到了一位十几岁的女孩，他的日常生活彻底改变了。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE146777.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
